Reference usage:
<Picture 1> is the primary character, clothing, room, lighting and environment reference.
<Picture 2> is an additional identity, facial-expression and early-2000s candid-photography reference.
Do not treat the two pictures as first and last frames. Keep the entire shot inside the bedroom from <Picture 1>.

integrated_multimodal_description:

One continuous 5-second highly realistic early-2000s slice-of-life shot.

Preserve the same young East Asian woman from <Picture 1>, including her dark loosely tied hair, soft natural facial structure, minimal makeup, gray oversized T-shirt, realistic skin texture and relaxed everyday temperament. Use <Picture 2> only to reinforce her natural candid smile, loose strands of hair and authentic early-2000s snapshot feeling.

The setting remains entirely inside the small lived-in bedroom from <Picture 1>: old CRT-style computer monitor, crowded wooden desk, stacked books, pinned photographs on the wall, blue plaid bedding, small window, slightly messy personal belongings. Everything should feel genuinely used rather than art-directed.

0.00-1.40 seconds:
Begin with the woman already sitting at the desk, resting one side of her face lightly against her hand and looking absent-mindedly toward the wall of photographs. She blinks naturally and shifts her gaze across the pinned photos with a quiet, slightly distracted expression.

1.40-3.40 seconds:
She notices one particular photograph near the desk. Without rushing, she lowers her supporting hand, leans forward, and reaches toward it. Her fingers gently remove the small printed photograph from the wall. Her body follows the movement naturally, and a few loose strands of hair fall lightly across her cheek.

3.40-5.00 seconds:
She brings the photograph closer and looks at it briefly. Her expression softens into a very small genuine smile. She then gives a short glance toward the window as if a memory has returned. End immediately on that subtle emotional shift.

Camera:
One restrained handheld medium shot with subtle early-digital-camera instability. Begin around chest height, drift in slightly during the reach, and hold closer on her expression at the end. No dramatic dolly, no orbit, no crane movement.

Visual style:
Extremely photorealistic early-2000s Chinese personal photography, inexpensive consumer digital camera look, mild sensor noise, subtle film grain, slightly soft optical detail, restrained dynamic range, faint cool-green shadows, imperfect white balance, natural window light, realistic skin pores, no beauty-filter skin, no fashion-editorial polish.

Performance:
All movement must be understated and physically believable. No exaggerated smiling, posing, hair flipping or model-like gestures. Fingers must interact correctly with the photograph. Preserve facial identity and body proportions throughout.

Avoid:
modern luxury interior, smartphone, modern laptop, exaggerated cinematic lighting, glossy commercial skin, plastic face, aggressive depth of field, excessive motion blur, fashion posing, sudden scene change, outdoor transition.
